item.title: Australia’s Spilt Milk Festival Confirms 2026 Return
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome back to the latest in music news. If you're a fan of Australian music festivals, we've got some exciting news for you. Spilt Milk festival has officially confirmed its return for 2026!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "After months of silence, the festival dropped a teaser video on social media, featuring members of the public sharing their favorite Aussie music festivals. The clip ends with the big reveal: Spilt Milk is back in 2026. Although, we don't have any details on dates, locations, or the lineup just yet."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This announcement comes after a successful 2025 edition, which sold out across all four host cities: Ballarat, Perth, Canberra, and the Gold Coast. Last year's lineup was stacked, with headliner Kendrick Lamar, and other notable acts like Doechii, Dominic Fike, and ScHoolboy Q."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Spilt Milk has come a long way since its launch in Canberra in 2016. It's now one of Australia's largest touring festivals, with a history of featuring big-name artists like Post Malone, Lorde, and Flume. And, interestingly, the 2019 Ballarat event marked Juice WRLD's final live performance, just a week before his passing."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for now. We'll be keeping an eye on Spilt Milk's 2026 campaign, and we can't wait to see what's in store. Stay tuned for more music news and updates!"
